continuity.notes: Trial of S004 before full-chapter character planning. Anonymous practitioners are illustrative, not depictions of named historical figures.

scene_brief.mode: three paths in one continuous devotional landscape
must_show: Left: an anonymous mature ascetic peacefully contemplating in a simple rock shelter, a closed unlettered palm-leaf bundle nearby
Middle: an anonymous householder mindfully offering food to another person as an act of duty, without money or market selling
Right: a small group of devotees singing and praying toward a modest shrine containing the established youthful Guruvayurappan form
Treat knowledge, action and devotion as coherent paths with different dispositions, not opposing sides

stanzas.alt: Knowledge, selfless action and devotion as three paths to the Lord

landscape.composition_override: One continuous wide composition with three readable areas linked by a flowing path; no collage panels or text.

portrait.composition_override: Recompose a rising path connecting contemplation below, service midway and devotional shrine above; do not crop the landscape.
